experiment.name: Forest Topology V8
experiment.purpose: Validate Vulkan BLOCK_INT8_64 decode and non-contiguous scatter before controlled inference-path integration.

limitations: V8 uses deterministic synthetic Orange-like non-contiguous geometry.
V8 does not modify llama.cpp or the OpenMind inference graph.
Queue submission, output clearing, and fence synchronization are included.
The CPU implementation is a direct reference loop rather than an optimized SIMD production baseline.
V8 is a kernel microbenchmark and does not establish end-to-end inference speedup.

protocol: capture a real activation at one controlled injection candidate
encode the activation using the validated Orange representation
leave original activation unchanged for model continuation
next_gate.purpose: Run Forest decode/scatter beside a real llama.cpp activation without modifying the model's authoritative activation.

supported: Standalone Vulkan compute performs the Forest BLOCK_INT8_64 decode operation.
Vulkan non-contiguous scatter reproduces the CPU reference exactly across all 25 tested benchmark shapes.
GPU execution crosses over against the CPU reference as request size or batch size increases.
Batch sizes 16, 64, and 256 show a GPU advantage from the smallest tested 12.5 percent access fraction.
